holidays.descBn: ১৯৫২ সালের ২১ ফেব্রুয়ারির ভাষা শহীদদের স্মরণে, বিশ্বজুড়ে আন্তর্জাতিক মাতৃভাষা দিবস হিসেবে পালিত।

meta.accuracyNote: Fixed-date Bangladesh public holidays and international days are recurring annual dates. Islamic dates below are CALCULATED from the Umm al-Qura tabular calendar via the JavaScript Intl API and are marked 'tentative' — they may differ by a day from the official dates announced in Bangladesh after local moon sighting. Variable-date holidays whose dates are announced each year by government gazette (for example Durga Puja / Bijoya Dashami and Buddha Purnima) are intentionally NOT given fixed dates here; add them as custom holidays when announced.
